text: We got married last year in May in Tbilisi. We just went in the morning to House of Justice in Tbilisi and there were there people who approach you to help. We just went with 2 random women, they were very helpful, served also as our witnesses and much cheaper than the agencies you can book in advance. An important thing that is not mentioned often is that, after you get the marriage certificate, you need Hague Apostile on it, there in Georgia (they also helped us with this, we paied for urgent Apostile and the second day we had it and the process was finished. Afterwards, we translated the marriage certificate here in Israel from Georgian to Hebrew directly, not from Georgian to English and then Hebrew.
